text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity. The history of 33 weeks gestation, onset within hours of birth, and clinical signs of grunting and retractions are classic for surfactant deficiency. The expected chest X-ray will likely show a ground-glass appearance with air bronchograms.
